text:
elaine: Hey team — quick design review for the API keys flow. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc/keys-redesign (check Rotate/Revoke modal + legacy-key empty state). Main asks: 1) confirm modal copy & CTAs, 2) keyboard/focus order and screen reader hints, 3) scope visibility on create. PTAL. First screenshot attached. @morgan @katie
morgan: Looks clean. My first thought: the rotate modal's primary CTA says "Rotate key" and the secondary "Keep old key" — that feels backward. Primary should be action that keeps app working while we issue a new key. Maybe "Create rotated key" / "Cancel". Also are we showing the new key once created? need notice about copy-only view.
katie: Agree on CTA. Also accessibility nit: focus should land on the confirmation checkbox ("I will update my apps") before the primary action, not after. Keyboard users need explicit focus order. Add aria-describedby to the checkbox linking to the warning text.
sam: Copy tweak: current warning "Rotating will invalidate the old key immediately" -> suggest "Rotating replaces the current key. Existing sessions using the old key will stop working right away." clearer. Could add a small help link "What happens on rotate?" that opens drawer.
elaine: Good. On showing the new key — product wants to show it once and then mask it after navigation. Thoughts on copy for the ephemeral success card? My draft: "New key created. Copy now — this value is shown only once." buttons: "Copy key" (primary) and "Got it" (secondary).
morgan: For screen readers, include an aria-live region announcing "New key created" and "Key copied" on copy button press. Also ensure Copy button is not focus-trapped; allow Esc to close the toast.
katie: Empty state: current "No API keys yet" page shows a big illustration and a single CTA "Create key". Can we add "Recommended permissions" checklist inline so users pick at creation time? Maybe a small "Start with read-only" toggle.
sam: Permissions UX: When creating, we show a compact role picker but can't see which routes each role affects. Suggest expand-on-hover or a collapsible "what does this grant" with sample endpoints. Also include "Least privilege recommended" tooltip.
elaine: Good call. Another nit: the revoke flow confirmation modal currently uses red primary button "Revoke". That's fine but we need a double-confirm pattern for admin-level keys. Suggest a text input to type the key name for admin-level revokes, or require a checkbox + reason field for audit logs.
katie: For keyboard users, ensure modal close button is labeled "Close dialog" and focus returns to the originating row in the table after close. Tab order inside the modal: checkbox -> reason textarea -> primary button. That maps to screen reader expectations.
morgan: Visual: the key table has "Last used" column with relative times; please add tooltip with exact timestamp and timezone. Also add an icon for "rotatable" vs "machine-token".
elaine: Thanks all — I'll update Figma with the CTA text, aria hints, and the ephemeral card copy. I'll also add a prototype showing focus order. If anyone wants to pair on the a11y checks, ping me. :thumbsup:
